query:
SELECT
                peers.peer_id,
                (
                    SELECT swap_states.state
                    FROM swap_states
                    WHERE swap_states.swap_id = peers.swap_id
                      AND json_extract(swap_states.state, '$.Alice.BtcLocked') IS NOT NULL
                    ORDER BY swap_states.id ASC
                    LIMIT 1
                ) AS "btc_locked_state?: String"
            FROM peers
            WHERE peers.swap_id = ?
